meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能帮你查看或配置 claude-mem 的云端同步:查询同步状态、写入 cmem.ai 连接信息,并验证是否连通。
howto.when: 当你说“set up cloud sync”、“sync my memories”等关键词,或要求把记忆库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.note: Claude 会查询并报告设备 ID、待同步条数等。

say.text: 把我的记忆备份到 cmem.ai

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check or configure cloud sync for claude-mem: query sync status, write cmem.ai credentials, and verify connectivity.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like 'set up cloud sync', 'sync my memories', etc., or ask to back up/sync your memory database to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Claude asks for the three connection values from cmem.ai Connect.
Claude checks and reports device ID and pending counts.

say_en.text: Back up my memories to cmem.ai.
say_en.note: Needs token, user ID, and SyncHub URL from you.
